records.title: Cite-only docs-backed run
records.description: An operator runs the playbook against a repository that contains only plaintext docs under reference_docs/cite/ and expects every startup surface to treat the run as docs-backed.
steps: Operator prepares reference_docs/cite/spec.md with no top-level reference_docs file
The runner evaluates documentation state and warning conditions
The run proceeds as docs-backed without a code-only warning

records.title: README-only or binary-only docs tree
records.description: An operator points the playbook at a repository whose reference_docs tree contains only README or binary files and expects the documentation-state surfaces to agree that no recognized docs are present.
steps: Operator prepares a README-only or PDF-only reference_docs tree
The runner evaluates documentation state and warning conditions
All operator-visible surfaces report code-only mode consistently

records.title: Tier 4 ingest of reference docs
records.description: Phase 1 loads Tier 4 context from reference_docs/ and should receive only the documented top-level plaintext files, not nested archival folders.
steps: Phase 1 loads Tier 4 context from reference_docs/
The ingest helper enumerates top-level plaintext files
Nested non-cite directories are excluded from the returned context

records.title: Bootstrap self-audit doc mirroring
records.description: A maintainer mirrors curated bootstrap docs into reference_docs/ and expects both top-level context files and cite/ formal docs to remain available in their proper locations.
steps: Maintainer populates docs_gathered/ with top-level docs and cite/ docs
The bootstrap helper mirrors the source corpus into reference_docs/
The resulting tree preserves top-level and cite/ placement

records.title: Phase 1 completion gate
records.description: The runner validates quality/EXPLORATION.md at the end of Phase 1 and must block progression if mandatory sections or content depth are missing.
steps: Phase 1 writes quality/EXPLORATION.md
The validator checks the required exploration shape
Phase 2 remains blocked until the artifact is structurally complete

records.title: Archived bug-summary generation
records.description: Archive rendering reads BUGS.md from a finished run and must preserve the bug count encoded by canonical titled headings.
steps: An archived run contains a canonical BUGS.md file
Archive helpers extract bug sections and severity totals
INDEX.md and RUN_INDEX.md reflect the real bug counts

records.title: Direct Phase 1 role-map writeout
records.description: A direct skill-driven run writes quality/exploration_role_map.json before any runner-specific post-processing and still reaches a valid gate-ready role map shape.
steps: Phase 1 writes a raw role map with files[] and provenance
Normalization or validation produces the canonical role-map shape
Gate validation accepts the normalized output

records.title: Historical-output-heavy repository inventory
records.description: Phase 1 inventories a repository dominated by prior quality/ artifacts and must continue to distinguish intrinsic source from historical playbook output.
steps: Tracked files include large quantities of historical quality output
Role-map accounting classifies those files as playbook-output
Surface percentages keep historical artifacts out of code and skill shares
